title: Remote viewing a Guantanamo detainee: five white figures

tellings.quote: and then um lo and behold not too long later a major news media article came out I'm not going to say which one um that detailed this detainee's experience with uh what apparently the detainee perceived as as five white figures over his bed shaking his bed

plain: Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon intelligence official, says that a remote viewing session, an attempt to see distant people or places with the mind alone, focused on a detainee at Guantanamo Bay and picked up something strange, and that soon after a major news article he won't name described the detainee seeing "five white figures over his bed shaking his bed." Elizondo tells Michels this as something he was involved in, and mentions the physicist Hal Puthoff. If true, the remote viewing would have matched a real event that was reported only later.
